verdict.rationale: Baseten has a dedicated pricing-and-limits doc covering request/token rate limits, rate-limit response headers, tier upgrades (Basic→Pro/Enterprise via email verification), workspace budgets, and usage monitoring by API key/model. However, it lacks a detailed table of exact numeric limits per tier and doesn't cover rate limits for dedicated-deployment (non-Model-APIs) inference. missing for 10: explicit numeric limit tables per tier, independent/community corroboration of documented limits, coverage of dedicated deployment rate limits (not just Model APIs).
